explication: Ant Browser is a desktop app for managing isolated browser profiles, proxy bindings, browser cores, and automation, with local and remote backup/restore. The main user flow is profile management and filtering, then launching an instance with its selected core and proxy; automation and the Launch API can act on running instances. The graph retains documented backup, extension, fingerprint, and proxy-health capabilities. Source evidence is partial: README and indexed excerpts support the UI/API and documented features, but unsampled backend call chains are not asserted.
